### CVE-2017-3131
- Assigner: fortinet | Published: 2017-09-12 | Updated: 2024-10-25 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: Execute unauthorized code or commands
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial
- Exploit-DB 42388: Fortinet FortiOS < 5.6.0 - Cross-Site Scripting (webapps/hardware, 2017-07-28, verified=1)

A Cross-Site Scripting vulnerability in Fortinet FortiOS versions 5.4.0 through 5.4.4 and 5.6.0 allows attackers to execute unauthorized code or commands via the filter input in "Applications" under FortiView.

Affected:
- Fortinet, Inc. / Fortinet FortiOS: affected FortiOS versions 5.4.0 through 5.4.4 and 5.6.0
